q: How does Paul describe the people he is writing to in this letter?
a: Paul describes the people he is writing to as saints, and as faithfully trusting in Christ Jesus.

q: With what has God the Father blessed believers?
a: God the Father has blessed believers with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ.

q: When did God the Father choose those who believe in Christ?
a: God the Father chose those who believe in Christ before the foundation of the world.

q: For what purpose did God the Father choose the believers?
a: God the Father chose the believers so they could be holy and blameless before him.

q: Why did God destine the believers in advance for adoption?
a: God destined the believers in advance because he was pleased to do it.

q: What do believers receive through the blood of Christ, God’s beloved one?
a: Believers receive redemption, the forgiveness of their trespasses through the blood Christ.

q: What will God do when the times for the completion of his plan come?
a: God will bring together everything in heaven and on the earth under Christ.

q: What seal did the believers receive when they heard the word of truth?
a: The believers were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.

q: Of what is the Spirit a down payment?
a: The Spirit is a down payment of the inheritance of believers.

q: What does Paul pray the Ephesians will be enlightened to understand?
a: Paul prays that the Ephesians will be enlightened to understand the hope of their calling and the glorious riches of Christ’s inheritance in the saints.

q: What did the same power that now works in the believers do in Christ?
a: The same power raised Christ from the dead and seated him at God’s right hand in the heavenly places.

q: What has God put under Christ’s feet?
a: God has put all things under Christ’s feet.

q: What is Christ’s position of authority in the Church?
a: Christ is the head over all things in the Church.

q: What is the Church?
a: The Church is Christ’s body.

q: What is the spiritual condition of all unbelievers?
a: All unbelievers are dead in their trespasses and sins.

q: Who is working in the sons of disobedience?
a: The ruler of the authorities of the air is working in the sons of disobedience.

q: By nature, what are all unbelievers?
a: All unbelievers are by nature children of wrath.

q: Why is God rich in mercy towards believers?
a: God is rich mercy because of his great love.

q: Where are believers seated?
a: Believers are seated in the heavenly places with Christ Jesus.

q: For what purpose has God created believers in Christ Jesus?
a: God’s purpose for believers in Christ Jesus is that they should walk in good works.

q: What is the spiritual condition of unbelieving Gentiles?
a: Unbelieving Gentiles are separated from Christ, alienated from Israel, strangers to the covenants, without hope and without God.

q: What has brought some Gentile unbelievers near to God?
a: Some Gentile unbelievers have been brought near to God by the blood of Christ.

q: How did Christ change the relationship between Gentiles and Jews?
a: Christ made believing Gentiles and Jews into one group, destroying the hostility that divided them.

q: What did Christ abolish in order to make peace between Jews and Gentiles?
a: Christ abolished the law of commandments and regulations in order to make peace between Jews and Gentiles.

q: On what foundation is God’s family built?
a: God’s family is built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus being the cornerstone.

q: What kind of building are believers becoming?
a: They are becoming a holy temple for the Lord.

q: Where does God dwell in the Spirit?
a: God dwells in the Spirit within believers.

q: For whose benefit did God give Paul his stewardship?
a: God gave Paul his stewardship for the benefit of the Gentiles.

q: What was made known to Paul?
a: The revelation about the mystery was made known to Paul.

q: To whom has God revealed what was not made known to the human race in other generations?
a: God revealed the hidden truth about Christ to his apostles and prophets.

q: What hidden truth has been revealed?
a: The hidden truth revealed is that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow sharers in the promise in Christ Jesus.

q: About what was Paul sent to help the Gentiles understand?
a: Paul was sent to help the Gentiles understand the administration of the mystery that was hidden from the ages in God.

q: Through what will the complex wisdom of God be made known?
a: Through the church the complex wisdom of God will be made known.

q: What does Paul say believers have because of faith in Christ?
a: Paul says believers have boldness and access with confidence because of faith in Christ.

q: What is named and created after the Father?
a: Every family in heaven and on earth is named and created after the Father.

q: How does Paul pray for the believers to be strengthened?
a: Paul prays for the believers to be strengthened with power through God’s Spirit.

q: What does Paul pray that the believers will be able to understand?
a: Paul prays that the believers will be able to understand how wide and long and high and deep is the love of Christ.

q: What does Paul pray will be given to the Father to all generations?
a: Paul prays that the glory in the Church and in Christ Jesus will be given to the Father to all generations.

q: How does Paul urge believers to live?
a: Paul urges believers to walk in a way that is worthy of their calling.

q: What five types of people does Paul say Christ gave?
a: Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers.

q: What are these five types of people supposed to do for the church?
a: These five types of people are supposed to equip the believers for the work of service, for the building up of the body.

q: How does Paul say believers can be like children?
a: Believers can be like children by being tossed around and carried away by people’s trickery and erring deceit.

q: How does Paul say the body of believers is constructed?
a: The body of believers fits together, held together by each joint, each part working in the body’s growth, for the building up of each one in love.

q: How does Paul say the Gentiles walk?
a: The Gentiles walk in the futility of their minds.

q: What does Paul say has happened to the understanding of the Gentiles?
a: The understanding of the Gentiles has been darkened.

q: To what have the Gentiles handed themselves over?
a: The Gentiles have handed themselves over to sensuality to do every kind of impurity.

q: What does Paul say believers must put off?
a: Believers must put off what belongs to the old man.

q: What does Paul say believers must put on?
a: Believers must put on the new man.

q: To whom must a believer never give opportunity?
a: A believer must never give opportunity to the devil.

q: What must believers do instead of steal?
a: Believers must labor so that they may be able to share with the person who has need.

q: What kind of talk does Paul say must come out of the believer’s mouth?
a: No corrupt talk must come out of the believer’s mouth, but, instead, words that build up others.

q: Who must a believer not grieve?
a: A believer must not grieve the Holy Spirit.

q: What is a believer to do because God in Christ forgave him?
a: A believer must forgive others because God in Christ forgave him.

q: Who should believers imitate?
a: Believers should imitate God the Father as his children.

q: What did Christ do which was a pleasing aroma to God?
a: Christ gave himself up for the believers as an offering and sacrifice to God.

q: What attitude should instead be seen among believers?
a: Believers should instead have an attitude of thankfulness.

q: Who has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God?
a: The sexually immoral, impure, and greedy have no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

q: What is coming upon the children of disobedience?
a: The wrath of God is coming upon the children of disobedience.

q: What are believers to do with the works of the darkness?
a: Believers are not to participate with, but instead expose, the works of darkness.

q: What is revealed by the light?
a: Everything is revealed by the light.

q: What should believers do since the days are evil?
a: Believers should redeem the time since the days are evil.

q: What leads to recklessness?
a: Getting drunk with wine leads to recklessness.

q: With what should believers speak to each other?
a: Believers should speak to each other with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs.

q: In what way should wives be subject to their husbands?
a: Wives should be subject to their husbands as to the Lord.

q: How should husbands love their wives?
a: Husbands should love their wives as their own bodies.

q: How does a person treat his own body?
a: A person nourishes and loves his own body.

q: What happens when a man is joined to his wife?
a: When a man is joined to his wife, they become one flesh.

q: How should Christian children treat their parents?
a: Christian children should obey their parents.

q: What are Christian fathers to do for their children?
a: Christian fathers are to raise their children in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

q: With what attitude should Christian slaves obey their masters?
a: Christian slaves should obey their masters in the honesty of their heart as for the Lord.

q: What should a believer remember about whatever good deed he does?
a: A believer should remember that for whatever good deed he does, he will receive a reward from the Lord.

q: What should a Christian master remember about his Master?
a: A Christian master should remember that his and his servant’s Master is in heaven, and that there is no favoritism with him.

q: Why must a believer put on the whole armor of God?
a: A believer must put on the whole armor of God to stand against the wicked plans of the devil.

q: Against whom does a believer battle?
a: A believer battles against governments and rulers of the realm of darkness and against spiritual forces of evil.

q: Why must a believer put on the whole armor of God?
a: A believer must put on the whole armor of God to stand against the wicked plans of the devil.

q: Which piece of the armor of God puts out the flaming arrows of the evil one?
a: The shield of faith puts out the flaming arrows of the evil one.

q: What is the sword of the Spirit?
a: The sword of the Spirit is the word of God.

q: How should believers conduct themselves in prayer?
a: Believers should pray at all times, persevering and watching for God’s answer.

q: What does Paul wish to have through the prayers of the Ephesians?
a: Paul wishes to have the word given to him with boldness when he speaks the gospel.

q: Where is Paul as he writes this letter?
a: Paul is in chains in prison as he writes this letter.
